steps.code:
# Now let me get all transactions for this month (May 2023). I'll paginate through all results.
all_transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    response = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        min_created_at="2023-05-01",
        max_created_at="2023-05-31",
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if isinstance(response, list) and len(response) > 0:
        all_transactions.extend(response)
        page_index += 1
    else:
        break

print(f"Total transactions found: {len(all_transactions)}")
for t in all_transactions:
    print(t["transaction_id"], t["amount"], t["sender"]["email"], t["receiver"]["email"], t["created_at"])
